summary: App: svelte-commerce, a SvelteKit storefront for 'Northfield Supply Co.' running on the stubbed Litekart backend. Before every view, the prelude opens /my and signs in as Megan Okafor through the sign-in dialog. Saved views: (1) home — homepage with hero, trust strip and category tiles; (2) category-listing (/furniture) — filter sidebar, sort control and product grid; (3) product-detail (/products/leather-sofa) — gallery, price/sale/stock badges, add to bag, collapsible specs and ratings breakdown; (4) order-history (/my/orders) — account sidebar and order cards with status badges; (5) order-detail (/my/orders/NF-24117) — status, items, shipments, addresses and payment summary. Couldn't capture: /cart is handled as a category route ('No products match'), and the header cart button reported 0 items, so the seeded saved bag didn't load and I left out the cart and checkout. On the furniture page the heading and breadcrumb read 'Sports & Outdoor' even though it lists furniture. On the order detail page the estimated arrival is a malformed date string, and the total ($320.44) doesn't add up from the subtotal ($295.00) plus free shipping. I didn't capture the wishlist, the addresses page or the journal because they reuse layouts already saved.
